overall: The AG found two violations: no adequate alternative public access to the June 17 virtual meeting, and a late response to an open meeting law complaint. The notice, discussion, and recording allegations were rejected.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 17 meeting lacked real-time public access, since the notice listed a Zoom location without any way to join.
allegations.key_passage: we again find that the Commission failed to provide adequate alternative means of access to its June 17 meeting, and therefore, the meeting was not accessible to the public, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice was amended within 48 hours of the June 17 meeting to add the stormwater fee appeals topic.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by amending the June 17 meeting notice to include this unanticipated topic.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission discussed stormwater fee assessments, a topic not specifically listed on the June 17 notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law as the questions from Mr. Souza were not anticipated by the chair 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair did not adequately announce that the June 17 meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: For the same reasons expressed in those determinations, we also find no violation here as the chair's statement satisfied the requirement that he inform attendees of any recording.

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged the Commission failed to respond in time to an October 23 Open Meeting Law complaint, even after an extension was granted.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to the October 23 complaint until January 21, 2021, 34 days beyond the extension granted by this office.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
